title: My Favorite Toy
description: Share about your favorite toy - what it is, why you like it, and how you play with it.

learning_objectives: Use present tense to talk about habits
example_sentences: My favorite toy is a teddy bear.
I like it because it's soft and cuddly.
I play with it every day.

title: My Pet (or Dream Pet)
description: Tell us about your pet or a pet you wish you had. What does it look like? What do you do together?

learning_objectives: Talk about daily routines with pets
example_sentences: I have a dog named Max.
He has brown fur and big eyes.
I walk him every morning.

title: My Favorite Food
description: Share your favorite food - what it tastes like, when you eat it, and why you love it.

learning_objectives: Use adjectives to describe taste and texture
example_sentences: My favorite food is pizza.
It tastes delicious and cheesy.
I usually eat it on weekends.

title: My Best Friend
description: Introduce your best friend - what they look like, what you do together, and why they're special.

example_sentences: My best friend is Sarah.
She is kind and funny.
We play together every day.

title: My Favorite Place
description: Describe your favorite place - where it is, what it looks like, and what you do there.

learning_objectives: Talk about activities at specific places
example_sentences: My favorite place is the park near my house.
It has a big playground and trees.
I go there to play and relax.

title: My Hobby
description: Share your favorite hobby - what you do, how you do it, and why you enjoy it.

example_sentences: My hobby is drawing.
I draw pictures of animals and nature.
I practice every day after school.

title: My Family
description: Introduce your family members and tell us what makes your family special.

learning_objectives: Talk about family members and relationships
example_sentences: I have a mom, a dad, and one sister.
We like to spend time together.
My family is special because we help each other.

title: A Special Day
description: Tell us about a special day you remember - what happened, who was there, and why it was special.

learning_objectives: Use past tense to tell stories
example_sentences: My birthday last year was very special.
My friends came to my party.
We played games and ate cake.

title: My Dream Job
description: Share what you want to be when you grow up and why this job interests you.

learning_objectives: Talk about future plans and dreams
example_sentences: I want to be a teacher when I grow up.
Teachers help children learn new things.
I think teaching is important and fun.

title: My Favorite Season
description: Talk about your favorite season - what the weather is like, what you do, and why you like it.

example_sentences: My favorite season is summer.
The weather is warm and sunny.
I love going to the beach in summer.

title: My Favorite Book or Movie
description: Share your favorite book or movie - what it's about and why you recommend it.

learning_objectives: Use descriptive language for characters and events
example_sentences: My favorite book is Harry Potter.
It's about a boy who goes to a magic school.
I recommend it because it's exciting and fun.

title: Something I'm Proud Of
description: Share something you accomplished or did well - what it was, how you did it, and how you felt.

example_sentences: I am proud of learning to ride a bike.
I practiced every day for a week.
Now I can ride without help!
